name: habit-terrarium
description: 习惯玻璃箱：每天完成习惯为微型生态缸注入生机，植物随坚持天数从种子长成森林
interaction: Each completed daily habit adds a new element to your living terrarium — a seed sprouts on day one, a stem emerges by day three, and branches unfurl over weeks of consistency. Skip a day and the ecosystem subtly dims, reminding you that growth needs nurture. Over time, your persistent streaks transform a barren glass jar into a thriving miniature forest, making every habit visually tangible.
